content: Mikaya osi njaakhi sa nguri Ahab
Ka cho attaan, anọng p'Aram ọmaana p'Israẹl egbong karim.
Yina, ka cho kw'ottong attaan, Jehoshaphat kw'ode ọvaarnọng kwa Juda ofona ọtza ore ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl.
Ọvaar kw'Israẹl okk'akhaan-nọng pẹ obena bi, “Bọng karong bi, maman bọ ọkhaam Ramọt-Gilead o, yina, yan wọ kwa mosi, mọtzọkh-ẹ ka mbọhk s'ọvaarnọng kw'Aram?”

Mẹ wọ, ọn-ọbọbh Jehoshaphat bi, “Na atzọn-m abẹ mọtza orima Ramọt-Gilead abẹ o?” Jehoshaphat obhina ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl bi, “Kaam nde macha kọ ade, arim-egbong paam ade macha pọ, nnyanyaang saam nde macha sọ.”
Yina, Jehoshaphat obiro oben ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl bi, “Ochedendik ode bi, kọ ror ndọhna s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.”

Mando kw'ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl oyeri asẹjaakhi p'apyiri anọng ẹnọhna, ọbọbh bẹ bi, “Ma nda nnima egbong ọmaana anọng pa Ramọt-Gilead ra a?” Bẹ abhina bi, “Rọhng, kkeri Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọtzọkha bẹ ọtzọkha okhe ọvaarnọng k'ọbọhk.”
Yina, Jehoshaphat ọbọbh bi, “Ọsẹjaakhi kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi owobh ma kwa mọfha ọdọhn o?”

Ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl obhina Jehoshaphat bi, “Otzim ọm-ọkhaama ọsẹjaakhi wani kw'okpen Mikaya, kw'ode nnwa kwa Imla, kwa am-ọfha orenga ma kẹ ọdọhn Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi. Yina, kaam idik kọdaakhi okhuri bi, ẹjaakhi ẹkkakka ch'ekhuri kaam komosi.” Jehoshaphat obhina bi, “Tte ọvaarnọng oningi odik-dema nwa ọgbaakhi.”
Mando kw'ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl oyeri ọkhaan-nọng kwẹ wani, oben bi, “Tzima Mikaya kw'ode nnwa kwa Imla, akwu m'ẹbaa nda.”

Iwa ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl, ọmaana Jehoshaphat kw'ode ọvaarnọng kwa Juda, asi mvaar-nya sabẹ awobha k'avaargbera pabẹ, k'ibe sa bẹ am-awobha agwuma abọkpamọma, ọbaanga ẹbaakhamma cha Samariya. Asẹjaakhi biphyir am-asi ẹjaakhi ma bẹ k'itzitzikha.
Zẹdẹkaya kw'ode nnwa kwa Kenaana okk'akkonga otzima osi abhik, oben bi, “Ma wọ ode odik kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọgbaakhi bi, ‘Bọng dima bẹ arima anọng p'Aram abẹ maa, bọng adimi bẹ emeni biphyir.’ ”
Asẹjaakhi mbonggo biphyir am-asi ẹjaakhi nduma dani, aben bi, “Bọng nima Ramọt-Gilead abẹ, akhem-ẹ, kkeri Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọ́tzọkh-ẹ ọtzọkha okhe ọvaarnọng k'ọbọhk.”
Ọkkaabh-ẹkkaabha kw'okk'ofona bi, ọtza oyeri Mikaya, oben-ẹ bi, “Kker e, asẹjaakhi mbonggo biphyir, asi ẹjaakhi ch'ekhema anang ọvaarnọng, ọbaan bi, kọ abira asi odem nwuma wani.”
Yina, Mikaya oben bi, “Odem nwa kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi orukhi akpen, kaam mgbaakh-ẹ odik obungikwẹ kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọgbaakh-m.”
Mada opyiri, ọvaarnọng ọbọbh-ẹ bi, “Mikaya, na mọfha ọtza orima Ramọt-Gilead abẹ o?” Mikaya obhina bi, “Rọhng atza akhem-ẹ, kkeri Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọ́tzọkh-ẹ ọtzọkha ọkhọ-ọ k'ọbọhk.”
Ọvaarnọng oben-ẹ bi, “Igbe iphaang nọ sa kaam nsọ-ọ achekhi ka che ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi bi, agbaakh-m odik-ọkka o?”

Mikaya on-obhina bi, “Kaam nne da anọng p'Israẹl biphyir araami ka mgbegbeho mach'arukhimaan p'ani okker-arukhimaan akhaam. Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben bi, ‘Anọng mba bẹ otzim-eden kakhaam. Tte ọnọng kpenamkpen ọbhana k'odidiri.’”
Ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl oben Jehoshaphat bi, “Ira kọ ndimi mgbaakhi bi, ẹjaakhi ẹkkakka ch'ekhuri kaam komoso o?”
Mikaya ochina ororo oben bi, “Bhaanga atzim p'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi: kaam nne da Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi owobh ẹwọr k'ọvaar-gbera kwẹ, ttara ọhaabh f'owobh k'ẹrọng k'odimbọhk ttara kwabọhk kwẹ.
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben bi, ‘Anyi wọ ọbọhra Ahab ọfha ọtza orima Ramọt-Gilead abẹ, orenga mẹ ope?’ Ebhina ede ngọmi-ngọmi.
K'ekponga-nnam, egwugwuma efona ekwu ebe Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi k'itzitzikha eben bi, ‘Kaam mbọhr-ẹ ọbọhra.’
“Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọbọbh bi, ‘Arenga yan?’ “ ‘Kaam nda nde egwugwuma ch'ibhora k'ẹmma ch'asẹjaakhi pẹ biphyir.’ Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben bi, “ ‘Kọ ábọhr-ẹ ọbọhra, rọhng atza asi mando.’
“Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'egwugwuma ch'ibhora ọbọhk ọtta ẹnwa asẹjaakhi pọ biphyir. Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ẹjaakhi ch'itzama s'ikhebh-ọ ọsa.”
Mando kwa Zẹdẹkaya kw'ode nnwa kwa Kenaana obin ọtza obun Mikaya ọbọhk k'ohobem, ọbọbh bi, “Yan wọ kw'ira egwugwuma ch'efon k'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi en-ette kaam ọbọhk ẹgbaak atzim ẹnang-ọ o?”
Mikaya obhina bi, “Kọ áronga-oronga m'ewu nduma ch'arọbh bi, atza achubha k'ẹmaanggọ ẹtzaanga.”
Ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl ọnang ẹfa, oben bi, “Bọng dọhm Mikaya ọkpa nnam otzor Amọn kw'ode ọdabhi kw'odedenmon, ọmaana Joash kw'ode nnwa kw'ọvaarnọng
bọng ben bi, ‘Ọvaarnọng obeni bi: bọng ahok ayi nwa ka mgbakkọhbh, bọng aning-ẹ ọchattọhk f'oyongi brẹd ọmaana asi anangi maa, ngwuna k'odidiri.’ ”
Mikaya oben bi, “Idikha kọ akhun k'odidiri, mẹ wọ ode bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ka khaam koreng ọgbaak atzim.” Obiro ọttara bi, “Bọng biphyir, bọng mmaanga atzim paam!”
Obo kw'Ahab
Mẹ wọ, ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl, ọmaana Jehoshaphat kw'ode ọvaarnọng kwa Juda afona atza arima anọng pa Ramọt-Gilead abẹ.
Ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl oben Jehoshaphat bi, “Kaam ḿmona mkpa nndima nda egbong nda, yina, kọ fọra ẹvaarnya chọ.” Mando kwa ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl obhon mkpa, ọtza egbong.

Ode cha ọvaarnọng kw'Aram okk'adenho pẹ p'akpaar pa nnyanyaang mmindọr, anọng ẹrọbh obhiri jobh obhiri afa, ẹfa ọnanga bi, “Bọng ọnọng ọdọdọk, ọkhar-ọkhara obiro ọbar-ọbar o, abẹ karima, oyongi ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl.”
Mada adenho p'akpaar pa nnyanyaang mmindọr are Jehoshaphat, bẹ achibhi bi, “K'odik-ọkka, ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl wọ ma e.” Mando kwa bẹ abhakhi bi bẹ arim-ẹ abẹ. Yina, Jehoshaphat ọn-ọkpẹbh ẹmọng.
Mada adenho p'akpaar pa nnyanyaang mmindọr an-atzini bi, ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl arang, bẹ akwọbh-ẹ okhukhubh.

Yina, ọtta-ayuk wani ọn-ọkhọmikha ọtta oyuk, kw'oreng k'ọphaangi kw'ẹkhọma dani ch'egbongkpo py'ọfọr, okhum ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl. Mando kw'ọvaarnọng obeni ọyaar-ọkpaar kwẹ kwa nnyanyaang mmindọr bi, “Bhakhi ọkpaar, atzim-m abina m'egbongdam, kkeri bẹ akk'aam ọttọhk amuma.”

Wa egbong nda ewobh k'ewu obungichẹ. Bẹ atzọkha ọvaarnọng abe idumsẹ m'ọkpaar kwa nnyanyaang okkeri itzitzikha k'Aram. Izi s'ifon k'ọttọhk f'omum ibyengi m'ibhokhi s'ọkpaar kwa nnyanyaang mmindọr maa, m'ẹchọhkha, ope.
Okwu opyiri ma nchọhkhabọhk, bẹ agwon ẹmọng k'ibhingabe s'arim-egbong p'Israẹl aben bi, “Ojinọng kpenamkpen ọkpa nnam ọbhana k'obhon kwẹ. Ojinọng kpenamkpen ọrọhng ọbhana k'ẹkhọma chẹ e!”
Iwa ọvaarnọng ope, bẹ atzim-ẹ akhuna akwu anọhnga ka Samariya.
Bẹ atza agbobhi ọkpaar kwa nnyanyaang mmindọr, k'esipe dani cha Samariya (kẹ da azaza am-agbobha asi), mpfa mbiri nttaakhi izi sẹ, atzor mach'atzim p'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi akk'ẹjaakhi asa.

Idik idọdọk s'ẹvaar ch'Ahab, attar idik s'osi biphyir, ẹvaar-ttọhmma ch'osi otzima ekpo macha nnyiha odokha, ọmaana idedenmon s'osi igaangi, bẹ akkẹri sẹ ka nnwẹr kw'itzamadik s'ikhuri avaarnọng p'Israẹl.
Wa Ahab ope otzor ab'otte. Ahaziya kw'ode nnwa kwẹ on-okwu ọdabh ẹvaar.
Jehoshaphat kw'ode ọvaarnọng kwa Juda
Iwa Jehoshaphat kw'ode nnwa kw'Asa okwu ode ọvaarnọng kwa Juda, ka cho kw'ottong anna kw'Ahab okk'ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl ọda.
Wa Jehoshaphat ode ọvaarnọng k'ogbe kw'ode cho ẹrọbh obhiri chi, ọdabh Jẹrusalẹm ka cho ẹrọbh obhiri azen. Wa ọkka okpen Azuba, kw'ode nnwa kwa Shilhi.

Wa osi odik kpenamkpen otzor-otzor k'itzitzikha s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, otzor ka ndọkhi s'otte Asa, sẹ kotten oji. Yina, wa okpokpobhabe f'ọyaankpa kọvọhkhi, anọng mba am-achina ororo asi njafọhni, abira akwọmi insẹns m'obe mva.
Wa Jehoshaphat obiro oruk k'odidiri ttara ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl.
Idik idọdọk s'ẹvaar cha Jehoshaphat, idik s'osi ọmaana mgbong sẹ s'orim, bẹ akkẹri sẹ ka nnwẹr kw'itzamadik s'ikhuri avaarnọng pa Juda.
Wa ọvọhkhi akhapa p'azaza p'ijinọng p'iwa arikhi m'ẹkhọma nda biphyir, k'ogbe kw'otte Asa, ọkk'ọpa.
M'ogbe nwuma, wa ọvaarnọng k'Edom kode. Ọdabhi-ẹkhọma wọ iwa ode ọvaarnọng.
Wa Jehoshaphat osi akpaar p'asi pa Tarshish k'ọhaabh p'om-otzima ọtza odebh gol k'Ophir. Yina, wa bẹ kayaari atza ibe, bẹ atzem k'Ẹziyọn-Gẹbẹr.
M'ogbe nwuma, Ahaziya kw'ode nnwa kw'Ahab oben Jehoshaphat bi, “Tte ajinọng paam ayaar akpaar ttara ajinọng pọ.” Jehoshaphat obhum.
Iwa Jehoshaphat ope otzor ab'otte, bẹ anọhng-ẹ k'odedenmon kwa Devid kw'ode otte. Jehoram kw'ode nnwa kwẹ on-okwu ọdabh ẹvaar.
Ahaziya kw'ode ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl
Iwa Ahaziya kw'ode nnwa kw'Ahab okwu ode ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl ka Samariya ka cho afa, ka cho kw'ottong cho chi obhiri afa pa Jehoshaphat okk'ọvaarnọng ọda ka Juda.
Wa osi itzama k'itzitzikha s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, okhuri da otzori ka ndọkhi s'otte ọmaana ọkka ttara ka ndọkhi sa Jẹroboam kw'ode nnwa kwa Nẹbat, kw'osi anọng p'Israẹl asi ẹkhọngkwuri.
Wa ọhak eho obiro okpobha Baal, mach'iwa otte ọkk'ọsa, ojemi ittem-dọkhiji s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kw'anọng p'Israẹl.
